title: ISPD-Opt Author-Generated Intent-Style Email Subset
description: An exact, screened release of 1,800 author-generated email records used in the study Intent-Style Evaluation of Machine-Generated Phishing Email Detection. The release contains 900 machine-generated legitimate and 900 machine-generated phishing records, with no human-source rows.
